title: CAMPBELL'S® One-Pan Taco Skillet
description: Love tacos? Then you'll love this quick and easy taco-inspired rice skillet that everyone in the family can customize with their preferred toppings.
ingredients: 1 (10 ounce) can CAMPBELL'S® Condensed Roasted Red Pepper & Tomato Soup

steps.text: Heat large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Break up meat in skillet; add red and green peppers. Cook, stirring often, 8 minutes or until meat is cooked through; drain off fat.
Add soup, water, chili powder, and onion powder; stir. Bring to a boil.

Stir in rice and corn; cover. Simmer on low heat 5 minutes or until rice is tender. Sprinkle with cheese; cover and remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and cheese is melted.
